trans-unit.source: TYPO3 Core Version:Access the official TYPO3 API (get.typo3.org) to retrieve details about insecure and unmaintained TYPO3 releases.
File storage: UID of the (local) file storage (sys_file_storage) the command "nagios:extensionlist:write" writes the configuration file to (empty = default storage).
Configuration file: Path and file name within the file storage. The file is delivered by the web server without TYPO3.
Source site: Identifier of the site the command fetches the generated configuration from (empty = first site).
Source path: Path (relative to the site base) which delivers the generated configuration (page type of the frontend plugin).
